objective: Close Wave 3 A7: BeBrain local core must be the default cheap local route, backed by real local model discovery and explicit fallback when no local backend is usable.

criteria.promise: Local Ollama/LM Studio backends collapse to the stable Brain-facing provider identity bebrain.local.core, while cloud providers keep their own identity and Apple Foundation Models remains runtime-discovered only.

Local model discovery uses each provider's real catalogue endpoint, filters non-chat embedding models, honors a saved model only while it is actually installed, and never sends a hardcoded missing model to a local runner.
With no explicit cloud preference and both local and cloud providers available, ordinary AI verbs route to local; confidential/local-only work cannot fall back to cloud when local is unavailable.

verification_gates.expected: Local providers report bebrain.local.core; Foundation Models is absent unless runtime availability is true.

verification_gates.procedure: Run LocalModelsTests and focused model-choice tests.
verification_gates.expected: Ollama and LM Studio catalogues parse, embedding models are ignored for chat, saved missing models are not selected, selected installed model is used in the HTTP body.

verification_gates.procedure: Run AIVerbTests and inspect captured request hosts/bodies.
verification_gates.expected: Default ordinary verb uses the local endpoint/model and does not call cloud; local-only/confidential cloud fallback is refused.

recon_evidence: BELLanguageModelProvider, LocalModels, AIVerbs, ModelRoutingTests, BELLanguageModelProviderTests and LocalModelsTests were inspected. The backend exists; this ticket closes missing end-to-end proof and any small contract gaps.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Focused tests proving local default route and installed-model selection.
